title: Bivariate stability with a full right threshold
statement: Let $\Phi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function, and let $B_\rho(\alpha,\beta)$ be the standard Gaussian product measure of the set of $(x,y)\in\mathbb R^2$ for which $\Phi(x)\le\alpha$ and $\Phi(\rho x+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,y)\le\beta$. For all $\rho\in\mathbb R$ and $0\le\alpha\le1$, one has $B_\rho(\alpha,1)=\alpha$.
